method: Visual inspection of final CPU renders exported from the application mesh; these are not browser screenshots.

findings.detail: Portal visible through Cavallers corridor; adjacent roof no longer obscures it. Artificial angular earth bank removed. Paved transition remains supported and joins the mapped street.
Church threshold ends at local x20.35, y+0.12; context landing begins at x20.35, y+0.12. The dark strip in the image is shade across continuous geometry.
West facade is unobstructed; the earlier protruding internal piers are absent and roof ends are closed.
Immediate street fronts, source parcel volumes, ordinary roofs and existing civic Plaza Mayor read as one connected setting. No second Plaza Mayor or Almudin was introduced.

remainingLimitations: Domestic facade openings and secondary roof envelopes are schematic, while source footprints are preserved.
Church floor registration and derived stair tread count accommodate the display MDT; they are not a measured levelling survey.
